page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ine.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The underlying hardware is based on an Intel Xeon processor from the SPR model family, running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance type.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c8ine.xlarge offers a compute-focused resource profile. This configuration is designed for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of excess memory, such as web serving, batch processing, and lightweight compute-intensive applications.
